label: Faction
description: One group with a shared purpose: what it exists for, who belongs, where its power comes from, where its members pull apart and where it stands in the story's conflict. Its individual members are characters.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: What the group exists to do, gain or protect, stated as an aim its own members would recognise.

fields.label: Kind of group
fields.help: The broad kind of group this is, which shapes what a reader expects of its ranks, customs and loyalties.

fields.label: How openly it exists
fields.help: How openly the group exists in the story's world, and how far outsiders' picture of it matches what it really does.

options.label: Openly known for what it is
Known only by a respectable front

fields.label: Origins
fields.help: How and why the group came into being and which parts of its past its members still invoke, with single dated events kept as timeline events.

fields.label: Shared beliefs and code
fields.help: The beliefs members hold in common and the conduct the group demands of them, one per item, leaving how the wider world works to world rules.

fields.label: Membership
fields.help: Who belongs to the group, how someone comes to join it, and how a member leaves or is put out.

fields.label: How it is led
fields.help: How authority inside the group is held and handed on, apart from which characters hold it now.

fields.label: Source of power
fields.help: What gives the group its leverage over others, such as numbers, wealth, force, knowledge, law or belief.

fields.label: Reach
fields.help: How far beyond its own members the group's power is felt in the story's world when the story opens.

scaleLabels.low: Felt only by its own members

fields.label: Methods and limits
fields.help: How the group uses its leverage in pursuit of its purpose, and any line it will not cross to get there.

fields.label: Internal tension
fields.help: Where members disagree or compete with one another, and what each side of that disagreement wants for the group.

fields.label: Place in the central conflict
fields.help: Where the group stands in the book's central conflict, whom it helps or hinders, and what it wants from the outcome.

fields.label: Weak points
fields.help: What could break the group's hold or split it apart, one per item, whether or not anyone in the story has seen it yet.

fields.label: Change across the book
fields.help: How the group's strength, aims or unity shift between the first page and the last, and what in the story brings that about.
